final: WITH acc AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amt FROM account a JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), reg AS (SELECT region, AVG(avg_amt) AS fig FROM acc GROUP BY region), overall AS (SELECT AVG(fig) AS m FROM reg), above AS (SELECT AVG(fig) AS m2 FROM reg, overall WHERE reg.fig > overall.m) SELECT reg.region, reg.fig AS figure, reg.fig - overall.m AS excess_over_avg, reg.fig / above.m2 AS ratio_to_above_avg FROM reg, overall, above WHERE reg.fig > overall.m
